description: A thin protective metal plate laid between leaves of a book so a sheet folded over it can be trimmed with a knife without cutting or marking the pages beneath.
name: cutting tin

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XVII, p.254. Internet Archive.
